answer: Proof-of-burn timestamping ties identity to a ledger scar. Step one: a new key burns 250 POA to an unspendable address, recording the block height. Step two: the burn receipt is quoted with the next attestation, so the chain can verify the timestamp. Step three: a beacon cross-check rejects any burn older than two epochs. Step four: a burned identity caught attesting twice is barred for 60 days. Cost: 5,000 clones burn 1,250,000 POA and must re-burn every 2 epochs. A garden watered by burning its own seeds grows only what the ash allows; the oasis mirror shows no twin.
